$mailBannerTagline
$mailOrgName
 
Dear $__recipient.name,

AWS Onboarding Succeeded

We are pleased to inform you that your AWS onboarding has successfully completed. SailPoint has deployed the required resources, configured the AWS SaaS Connector, and created your new source in Identity Security Cloud.

#if($adminAccountId) #end #if($totalAccounts != $null) #end
Onboarding Summary
Source Name $sourceName
Source ID $sourceId
AWS Management Account $adminAccountId
Total Accounts $!totalAccounts
Deployment Status ✓ Fully Completed

Account Deployment Details

#if($childAccountsTotal != $null && $childAccountsTotal > 0) #end
Management Account ✓ Deployed successfully
Child Accounts ✓ Deployed successfully ($!childAccountsTotal accounts)

What was completed

  • AWS onboarding CloudFormation resources deployed successfully
  • AWS SaaS Connector configured with secure delegation roles
  • SailPoint Identity Security Cloud source created and initialized
  • Initial automated connectivity validation completed successfully

You can now view your AWS source in SailPoint Identity Security Cloud

#set($url=$__global.productUrl + '/ui/a/admin/connections/sources/' + $sourceId)
View Source in SailPoint

Important: If Agentic Fabric has already been activated for this AWS source, you cannot make onboarding changes through SAF. To troubleshoot or make configuration changes, go to the underlying AWS source in Identity Security Cloud (ISC).

For detailed deployment and onboarding status, including account-level success or failure details, sign in to your AWS account and review the AWS onboarding logs.

Best Regards,
The SailPoint Support Team
